name: ate_chart
description: Build a chart for the user (read-only; the app draws it inline). kind: price = HSKSwap pool candles from on-chain Swap logs; cex = HashKey Global klines; oracle = Supra (vault oracle) vs APRO vs pool; spread = pool vs CEX gap in bps with the round-trip cost line; depth = price impact in bps for a ladder of trade sizes (live QuoterV2, both sides); volume = pool USD volume; pnl = the vault's realised + marked P&L curve; exposure = vault exposure vs its cap; budget = epoch budget spent vs cap. Indicators (EMA, SMA, VWAP, Bollinger, RSI, MACD, ATR, volume) are computed server-side; add them only when the user asks. compare adds the exchange and oracle prices on the same chart; drawings put levels, trendlines, zones, Fibonacci and notes on it; analyse returns plain findings (e.g. support tested 3 times) tied to drawings. markers adds journal decisions (buys, sells, no-trades). network=mainnet reads HashKey Chain mainnet market data even when the vaults run on testnet. Call when the user asks to see, chart, graph or plot something.

markers.description: Show journal decisions on the chart (default true for price and pnl)

network.description: vault = the daemon's chain (default); mainnet = HashKey Chain 177 market data

compare.description: ADDITIVE. Extra price lines on a price/cex chart: pool, cex (HashKey Global), oracle (Supra + APRO)

drawings.description: ADDITIVE. Drawings to show: hline (level at a.v), trend (a→b), zone (band a.v–b.v, optional times), fib (retracement a→b), text (note at a). Prices in USD, times in unix seconds. E.g. a 1% gap line = hline at exchange price × 0.99

analyse.description: ADDITIVE. Add a plain-language analysis (trend, range, support and resistance with touch counts, momentum, gap) tied to drawings. Information, not advice
